Rules Of Procedure Of The Provincial Assembly Of West Pakistan 1962
Rules Of Procedure Of The Provincial Assembly Of
West Pakistan 1962
[Gazette of West
Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 8th June 1962]
No. Gen-5-4/62/3167.?In exercise of the powers conferred by Article
231 of the Constitution of she Republic of Pakistan the Governor of West
Pakistan is pleased to make the following rules for regulation of the procedure
of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan until rules of procedure are made
by the said Assembly under clause (1) of Article 110 of the Constitution
:
1. Short title.?These rules may be
called the Rules of Procedure of the Provincial
Assembly of West Pakistan.
2.
Adoption of the Rules of Procedure of the National Assembly.?Subject to the
provisions of Rules 3 and 4 of these Rules, the procedure of the Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan shall be
regulated by the rules made by the President of Pakistan for regulation
of the procedure of the National Assembly, hereinafter referred to as the said
Rules.
3. Amendments
in the Rules of Procedure of the
National Assembly.?In the said Rules----
(a) any
reference to the term appearing in column 1 of Schedule I appended hereunder
shall, unless the context otherwise requires, be read as a reference to the
term mentioned against each in column 2 thereof ;
(b) wherever
a rule or sub-rule or a schedule is applicable only to the National Assembly or
the Central Government it shall not apply.
4. Standing
Committees.?(1) Instead of the Standing Committee pro?vided for by
the said Rules the following Standing Committees shall be constituted for the
Provincial Assembly of West Pakistan to deal with the subjects assigned in the
